notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address. It may have been moved, or the link may be incomplete.
notFound.presets: Or open one of the example targets

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your data is not affected. Try again, or return to the home page.

chunk.title: This page could not be loaded
chunk.body: The page files could not be downloaded. This usually happens after an update or when the connection drops. Reload to get the latest version.
